scope:
Execute the built debugger exports and cportlib instructions with UART I/O
modeled through Unicorn IN/OUT hooks. No kernel debugger or real UART attached.

tests.test: Uninitialized reads return no-data, null output returns error, early transmit performs no I/O
Invalid selections/rates rejected without I/O; missing UARTs fail discovery
Discovery/activation phases preserve selection and configure 38400 baud, 8N1, FIFO, interrupts off
Automatic selection prefers COM2 then COM1, with native 19200 default
Explicit COM1 through COM4 activate the requested detected UART
Poll consumes exactly one byte; get consumes next byte; empty polling is bounded
UART overrun/parity/framing errors report error; waiting receive handles delayed data
Waiting receive returns no-data after the actual cportlib timeout loop
Transmit waits for readiness; save/restore toggles native debugger state without changing direct UART settings
Disconnected UART produces no-data and failed reinitialization releases the claimed port
Installed kernel receive and break-in polling helpers consume bytes through the actual new HAL

limitations: IN/OUT model, not physical UART or xemu transport
Direct UART only; modem command protocol and ARC enumeration unsupported
